name: AirPlay 2 Multi-Room
description: Turns the kiosk into an AirPlay 2 speaker that groups with HomePods and other AirPlay 2 speakers for multi-room audio from an iPhone, iPad or Mac. Follows the sender's clock over PTP, which needs Shizuku running as root. Shows track info and cover art, publishes playback to Home Assistant and lowers audio while the voice assistant talks. Audio only. Not affiliated with Apple.
author: Ian White

settings.title: Speaker name
settings.description: The name shown in the AirPlay menu on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Leave empty to use this kiosk's device name.

settings.title: Lower AirPlay while the assistant talks
settings.description: Turn AirPlay audio down while Voice Satellite listens and answers.

settings.title: Wake the screen when playback starts
settings.description: Dismiss the screensaver and turn the display on when AirPlay audio starts.

settings.title: Now Playing card
settings.description: Show the track, artist and cover art over the dashboard: for a few seconds when the track changes, or for as long as audio plays.

settings.title: Port
settings.description: TCP port for AirPlay connections, 1024 to 65535. The default keeps clear of Kiosk Satellite's own AirPlay receiver.

settings.title: AirPlay device ID
settings.description: Generated on first start. Clear it to make Apple devices see this kiosk as a new speaker.

settings.title: Feature flags
settings.description: For troubleshooting only. Leave empty for the default (0x401FCA00,0x1C340, as shairport-sync advertises). See the README.
